definitions.utopia: AI broadly solves material problems — health, abundance, education
definitions.divergence: intelligence escapes the few — open weights, local models, many small actors
definitions.drift: attention eats everything — virality, slop, synthetic media, no direction
definitions.control: humans keep the leash — regulation, audits, lawsuits, treaties
definitions.terminus: the leash breaks badly — job losses, weapons, scams, existential risk
definitions.stagnation: the revolution stalls — winters, plateaus, overpromising, disillusion
definitions.transcendence: the horizon dissolves — superintelligence, minds beyond minds

sources.updated_from: Mac Studio ARI report (tailnet) report-ari.html — embedded <script id="ari-data"> JSON block, every week since 2026-04-06; the report is rebuilt daily, weeks dated after the as-of are not read
export.arxiv.org/api/query — cs.AI submission count per month; new complete months + the previous one re-fetched
epoch.ai/data/notable_ai_models.csv — full model list, 12-month windows derived locally
federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents — documents mentioning "artificial intelligence" per month; new complete months + the previous one re-fetched

api.github.com (keyless, no token) — 12 AI repos: stargazers_count every night, release lists re-fetched monthly (pages 2-5 once until the history is complete), commits per month via search total_count since 2019-01 (missing months first, then the last complete month re-checked); tools (method 0.5.0): new repos per month per AI-tool topic (llm, ai-agents, mcp, ai-tools) and in Lean, mathlib4 commits per month — same search rule — and 15 tool-layer repos' stars every night; every new public repo per month (method 0.6.0 — GitHub's own growth, the denominator of the tool and Lean counts), same search rule; budget ≤ 45 core + ≤ 150 search requests (and ≤ 8 min of search) a night, the rest next night

sources.pulls: Natural Earth 110m country polygons (map asset, fetched when upstream changes)

ourworldindata.org/grapher/<slug>.csv + .metadata.json — full history re-downloaded each night (19 charts: 8 world series, 12 country panels, 1 chart serving both)
eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov esearch — AI×biomed paper count per month; new complete months + the previous one re-fetched

sources.pulls: SDG series values (country×year, all areas, one request per series)

sources.updated_from: wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews — monthly en.wikipedia user views since 2015-07 (5 articles + all-pages total)

api.worldbank.org/v2/country/WLD/indicator/{NY.GDP.PCAP.KD,SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS} — full annual history; country panels (country/all) for the atlas, incl. population SP.POP.TOTL, its per-capita denominator (method 0.6.0)

refresh.utc_note: 12:30 UTC while Central European Summer Time applies; 13:30 UTC in winter (CET) — the timer fires at 14:30 local

ari.detail: event-sourced restriction pressure on AI agents — global platforms, scored weekly (English-language tech news + HN + OS-vendor blogs; bias B14)
ari.license: dweeb.xyz Agent Restriction Index — verbatim capture, © pipeline output, methodology at report §method

arxiv.detail: cs.AI preprints submitted worldwide (US, CN, EU authors largest); counts not split by country

epoch.detail: notable AI models attributed to the developer organisation's country (mostly US, CN, UK, EU, CA, KR, JP) — global industry, concentrated in a few countries

fedreg.detail: US federal rulemaking and notices only — no other government is covered

github.detail: 12 AI repositories on GitHub (US labs and companies, Alibaba Qwen, global contributor bases) plus 15 tool-layer repos, and search counts over every public repository (AI-tool topics, Lean) — activity is not split by country; GitHub itself is US-hosted
github.license: GitHub ToS — counts are facts; metadata via public API

ne.detail: country polygons for the map layer — geometry only, no indicators

noaa_gml.detail: one station: Mauna Loa Observatory (US-HI), the long-running reference for well-mixed global background CO₂ (bias B13)

owid.detail: World aggregates only (entity World / All geographies) — OWID compiles UN WPP, World Bank PIP, V-Dem, UCDP, Stanford AI Index; no regional series used

pubmed.detail: biomedical literature indexed by the US National Library of Medicine from journals worldwide

unsdg.detail: UN member-state reporting — ~250 areas, country×year SDG series
unsdg.license: UN terms — free reuse with attribution

who_gho.detail: 194 WHO member states reporting health indicators

wikimedia.detail: English-Wikipedia page views from readers worldwide — English-language skew disclosed (bias B1)

worldbank.detail: WLD aggregate over the 217 economies in World Development Indicators
